tasks.description: Upgrade Java Version from 17 to 25 LTS. Addresses issues: Java Version is not the latest LTS
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the configured Java version from 17 to Java 25 LTS only. Inspect and update all relevant Maven and runtime configuration (java.version in pom.xml, compiler/release settings, Maven wrapper/toolchain/CI or runtime files referencing the Java version). Correct applicable Java-version documentation (README.md mentions Java 17 and 'JDK 17 ou superior'). Do not upgrade Spring Boot, Spring Framework or Jakarta EE, and do not address cloud-readiness or Dockerfile findings. Build and run tests using JDK 25.
